papers.title_zh: 靶向脂质体纳米载体用于高效神经元mRNA递送
papers.source_body_en: Purpose Messenger RNA therapeutics enable rapid, transient protein expression without risk of genomic integration, but their delivery to post-mitotic neurons remains challenging. Here, we present a neuron-targeted liposomal platform designed to enhance mRNA delivery efficiency in neurons. Methods We engineered DOTAP: DOPE liposomes to promote nucleic acid loading, stability, and endosomal escape, incorporated PEGylation to improve biocompatibility and circulation, and functionalized the liposome surface with a rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG)-derived peptide for neuronal targeting. We assessed particle size and surface charge, mRNA encapsulation/loading across different lipid: mRNA ratios, cytotoxicity in HEK293T cells as a function of cationic lipid content and PEGylation, and transfection performance in HEK293T cells and primary neurons, benchmarking against a commercial transfection reagent, with functional mRNA delivery further demonstrated in midbrain organoids following microinjection. Results The system enabled efficient mRNA encapsulation, maintained favorable particle size and surface charge characteristics, and supported low cytotoxicity. Across formulations, mRNA loading increased with lipid: mRNA ratio, with only modest reductions following PEGylation. In HEK293T cells, higher cationic lipid content increased its toxicity, whereas PEGylation reduced membrane interactions and improved tolerability. Transfection studies identified the 50:10 DOTAP: DOPE composition as optimal, yielding robust mRNA expression. In primary neurons, RVG-functionalized PEGylated liposomes containing 10 mol% DOPE achieved gene expression levels comparable to those of a commercial transfection reagent at a 10:1 lipid:mRNA ratio. Notably, incorporating 0.1% w/w RVG significantly outperformed the commercial formulation, yielding >30% gene-delivery efficiency in primary neuronal cultures. In midbrain organoids, the optimized mRNA-loaded RVG-functionalized liposomes produced GFP mRNA expression overlapping with NeuN staining, demonstrating functional mRNA delivery and translation within three-dimensional neural tissue. Conclusions Neuron-targeted DOTAP: DOPE liposomes incorporating the RVG peptide represent a promising mRNA delivery system for neurological applications, achieving a favorable balance of potency, safety, and specificity and supporting transient gene modulation in the central nervous system.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将mRNA递送至终末分化的神经元的挑战,这对于开发有效的神经学应用mRNA治疗药物至关重要。背景指出,尽管mRNA治疗药物能够提供快速且短暂的蛋白质表达,而不会导致基因组整合,但实现mRNA向神经元的高效递送仍然是一个重大障碍。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一种针对神经元的脂质体平台的开发与测试,旨在提高mRNA的递送效率。该平台在HEK293T细胞、原代神经元和中脑类器官中进行了评估,并与一种商业转染试剂进行了比较。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员设计了DOTAP: DOPE脂质体以提高核酸负载量、稳定性和内体逃逸能力。他们进行了PEG化处理以增强生物相容性和循环性,并在脂质体表面功能化了一种源自狂犬病病毒糖蛋白(RVG)的肽,用于神经元靶向。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该系统实现了高效的mRNA封装,保持了有利的颗粒大小和表面电荷特性,并支持低细胞毒性。在不同配方中,mRNA负载量随着脂质与mRNA的比例增加而增加,PEG化后仅出现适度的降低。在HEK293T细胞中,较高的阳离子脂质含量会增加毒性,而PEG化则减少了膜相互作用并提高了耐受性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,优化的脂质体系统在神经元mRNA递送中实现了效力、安全性和特异性之间的良好平衡,支持中枢神经系统中的暂时基因调控。使用RVG功能化的脂质体代表了一种在神经学背景下的新型靶向递送方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果对开发安全有效的mRNA递送系统在神经学应用方面具有重要意义,可能推动治疗在涉及中枢神经系统的疾病中的发展。该系统能够将mRNA递送至中脑类器官,表明其在研究和治疗神经退行性疾病中的潜在用途。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和类器官模型,这可能无法完全代表体内情况。所依据的证据基于摘要数据,由于缺乏详细的临床或体内验证,研究结果的可信度中等。

papers.title: Application Research on mRNA Vaccine Technology in Infectious Disease Prevention and Control
papers.abstract: Compared with inactivated, subunit, and DNA nucleic-acid approaches, mRNA vaccines do not enter the nucleus and carry no risk of genomic integration; they are translated in the cytoplasm and can jointly induce humoral and cellular immunity. In vitro transcription and cell-free production also markedly shorten the interval from sequence acquisition to vaccine output. This paper summarizes the configurations of non-replicating, self-amplifying, and circular RNA vaccines, as well as the characteristics of PRR-mediated immune activation, and reviews key process technologies including the 5′ cap, UTRs, pseudouridine modification, dsRNA removal, and LNP delivery. At the application level, the discussion centers on the billion-scale administration of SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccines, booster immunization, and variant-component updating, while also reviewing progress and limitations in pipelines for influenza, rabies post-exposure prophylaxis, HIV, hepatitis B, and other diseases, and analyzing their public health significance in shortening emergency response windows and tracking strain drift. IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions remain the main constraints. Self-amplifying/circular RNA, multivalent combination vaccines, and inhalable mucosal delivery may help move this platform from a “single pandemic response” toward broader infectious disease prevention and control practice.
papers.journal: International Journal of Public Health and Medical Research

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease. It examines the application of mRNA vaccine technology in the prevention and control of rabies, including its potential for broader use in infectious disease management.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative summary of mRNA vaccine technology, discussing its configurations, immune activation mechanisms, and key process technologies. It does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: mRNA vaccines for rabies are non-replicating, do not integrate into the genome, and can induce both humoral and cellular immunity. They are translated in the cytoplasm and offer advantages over traditional nucleic-acid approaches.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limitations in mRNA vaccine technology, such as IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions. It also notes the need for further development in pipelines for other diseases like influenza, rabies post-exposure prophylaxis, and HIV.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that advancements in self-amplifying/circular RNA, multivalent combination vaccines, and inhalable mucosal delivery could expand mRNA vaccines from pandemic responses to broader infectious disease prevention. It also emphasizes the importance of addressing production and distribution challenges for effective rabies control.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the application of mRNA vaccine technology in rabies prevention and control. It highlights the advantages of mRNA vaccines, such as their non-genomic integration and ability to induce both humoral and cellular immunity. The paper summarizes the configurations of non-replicating, self-amplifying, and circular RNA vaccines, as well as key process technologies like 5′ cap, UTRs, pseudouridine modification, dsRNA removal, and LNP delivery. It also discusses the practical challenges of mRNA vaccine production, including IVT purity, ultracold-chain requirements, and accessibility in resource-limited regions. The review emphasizes the potential of mRNA vaccines to move beyond pandemic responses and into broader infectious disease prevention, suggesting future research directions such as self-amplifying RNA, multivalent vaccines, and mucosal delivery methods.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于狂犬病病毒和狂犬病疾病。它探讨了mRNA 疫苗技术在狂犬病防控中的应用,包括其在传染病管理中更广泛使用的潜力。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对mRNA 疫苗技术的叙述性总结,讨论了其配置、免疫激活机制和关键工艺技术。它并未明确报告数据库、检索日期或元分析方法。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 针对狂犬病的mRNA 疫苗是非复制型的,不会整合到基因组中,并且能够诱导体液免疫和细胞免疫。它们在细胞质中翻译,相较于传统核酸方法具有优势。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本综述指出了mRNA 疫苗技术的局限性,例如IVT纯度、超低温链要求以及资源匮乏地区的可及性。同时,它还指出需要在流感、狂犬病 暴露后预防和HIV等其他疾病的防控流程中进一步发展。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本综述建议,自扩增/环状RNA、多价组合疫苗以及吸入式黏膜递送技术的进步可能将mRNA 疫苗从疫情应对拓展到更广泛的传染病防控。它还强调了解决生产和分配挑战对于有效狂犬病防控的重要性。

papers.title_zh: mRNA 疫苗技术在传染病防控中的应用研究

papers.abstract_zh: 与灭活、亚单位和DNA核酸方法相比,mRNA 疫苗不会进入细胞核,且无基因组整合风险;它们在细胞质中翻译,可同时诱导体液免疫和细胞免疫。体外转录和无细胞生产也显著缩短了从序列获取到疫苗输出的时间间隔。本文总结了非复制型、自扩增型和环状RNA 疫苗的配置,以及PRR介导的免疫激活特征,并回顾了关键工艺技术,包括5′帽、UTRs、假尿苷修饰、dsRNA去除和LNP递送。在应用层面,讨论聚焦于SARS-CoV-2 mRNA 疫苗的十亿级接种、加强免疫和变异成分更新,同时回顾了流感、狂犬病 暴露后预防、HIV、乙型肝炎等疾病防控流程中的进展与局限,并分析了其在缩短应急响应窗口和追踪病毒株漂移方面的公共卫生意义。IVT纯度、超低温链要求以及资源匮乏地区可及性仍是主要限制因素。自扩增/环状RNA、多价组合疫苗以及吸入式黏膜递送可能有助于将该平台从“单一疫情应对”拓展到更广泛的传染病防控实践中。

papers.title: Ocular and Lacrimal Gland Involvement in Rabies: Histopathological and Molecular Evidence from Naturally Infected Animals
papers.abstract: Rabies is still a fatal zoonosis, and post-mortem confirmation is mainly based on examination of brain tissue.However, collection of brain material may be difficult under field conditions and may pose a biosafety concern.We investigated ocular involvement in naturally infected animals by histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing.Histopathology was conducted on 92 animals that tested positive for rabies via DFA.Ocular and lacrimal gland specimens (30 each) were independently selected for immunohistochemistry based on tissue availability, preservation, and adequacy to evaluate IL-6, IL-1β, TNFα, TLR3, TLR4, HSP70, CD3, and CD20.Molecular testing was performed on separate subsets of 50 fresh brain, 50 FFPE brain, and 50 vitreous humor samples selected based on specimen availability and analytical suitability.Typical lesions of rabies were observed, such as nonsuppurative meningoencephalitis, focal gliosis, and neuronal necrosis.There was no statistically significant difference in IL-6 positivity between ocular and lacrimal gland samples (P>0.05).HSP70 positivity was more frequent in lacrimal glands compared to ocular tissues (86.7% vs. 13.3%;P<0.0001), as was CD20 positivity (46.7% vs. 13.3%;P=0.0029).Rabies virus RNA was detected in 35/50 vitreous samples (70%) by LN34 qRT-PCR.The Ct values were generally higher in FFPE brain specimens than in fresh brain specimens.Detection of viral RNA in vitreous humor supports ocular involvement in centrifugal spread from the central nervous system.However, 15 samples of vitreous humor from DFA-positive animals were negative, suggesting that vitreous humor cannot be considered as an independent diagnostic specimen, but its potential role is supplementary and needs further evaluation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies remains a fatal zoonosis, with post-mortem confirmation typically relying on brain tissue examination. However, collecting brain material can be challenging under field conditions and may involve biosafety risks. This study investigated ocular involvement in naturally infected animals using histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Histopathology was conducted on 92 animals that tested positive for rabies via DFA. Ocular and lacrimal gland specimens (30 each) were independently selected for immunohistochemistry based on tissue availability, preservation, and adequacy to evaluate specific markers. Molecular testing was performed on separate subsets of 50 fresh brain, 50 FFPE brain, and 50 vitreous humor samples selected based on specimen availability and analytical suitability.
analysis.methods: Histopathology was performed on 92 DFA-positive animals. Ocular and lacrimal gland tissues were selected for immunohistochemistry to assess IL-6, IL-1β, TNFα, TLR3, TLR4, HSP70, CD3, and CD20. Molecular testing involved qRT-PCR on 50 fresh brain, 50 FFPE brain, and 50 vitreous humor samples, with selection based on specimen availability and analytical suitability.
analysis.main_results: There was no statistically significant difference in IL-6 positivity between ocular and lacrimal gland samples (P>0.05). HSP70 positivity was more frequent in lacrimal glands compared to ocular tissues (86.7% vs. 13.3%; P<0.0001), as was CD20 positivity (46.7% vs. Rabies virus RNA was detected in 35/50 vitreous samples (70%) by LN34 qRT-PCR.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The detection of rabies virus RNA in vitreous humor supports the involvement of the eye in centrifugal spread from the central nervous system. However, the fact that 15 vitreous humor samples from DFA-positive animals were negative suggests that vitreous humor cannot be considered an independent diagnostic specimen, but its potential role is supplementary and requires further evaluation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that ocular tissues, particularly lacrimal glands, may serve as alternative sites for evaluating immune responses in rabies infection. The potential use of vitreous humor as a supplementary diagnostic specimen could improve rabies surveillance and diagnosis in field settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the reliance on post-mortem specimens and the potential for variability in tissue preservation. The evidence is moderate, as the results are based on observational data and require further validation in larger studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated ocular involvement in naturally infected animals with rabies using histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing. It found that HSP70 and CD20 positivity was more frequent in lacrimal glands compared to ocular tissues, while IL-6 positivity showed no significant difference. Rabies virus RNA was detected in 70% of vitreous humor samples, supporting ocular involvement in centrifugal spread. However, the study highlights that vitreous humor cannot be considered an independent diagnostic specimen due to some negative results. The findings suggest that ocular tissues may be useful for evaluating immune responses in rabies infection, and that vitreous humor could serve as a supplementary diagnostic tool. The study's evidence is moderate due to its observational nature and reliance on post-mortem specimens.

elements_zh.methods: 对92只DFA阳性动物进行了组织病理学检查。选择了眼部和泪腺组织进行免疫组织化学检测,以评估IL-6、IL-1β、TNFα、TLR3、TLR4、HSP70、CD3和CD20。分子检测涉及对50份新鲜脑组织、50份FFPE脑组织和50份玻璃体液样本进行qRT-PCR检测,样本选择基于标本的可获得性和分析适宜性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在眼组织和泪腺样本中,IL-6阳性率之间没有统计学显著差异(P>0.05)。与眼组织相比,泪腺中HSP70阳性率更高(86.7% vs. 13.3%;P<0.0001),CD20阳性率也更高(46.7% vs. 狂犬病病毒)。通过LN34 qRT-PCR检测,35/50玻璃体样本(70%)中检测到RNA。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在玻璃体液中检测到狂犬病病毒 RNA支持了眼睛在中枢神经系统向周围扩散中的参与。然而,15份DFA阳性动物的玻璃体液样本均为阴性,这表明玻璃体液不能被视为独立的诊断样本,但其潜在作用是补充性的,需要进一步评估。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,眼部组织,特别是泪腺,可能成为评估免疫应答在狂犬病感染中的替代部位。玻璃体液作为补充诊断样本的潜在应用,可能在现场环境中提高监测和诊断的诊断效果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于对死后样本的依赖以及组织保存过程中可能存在的变异性。证据等级为中等,因为研究结果基于观察性数据,需要在更大规模的研究中进一步验证。

papers.source_body_en: Rabies is still a fatal zoonosis, and post-mortem confirmation is mainly based on examination of brain tissue.However, collection of brain material may be difficult under field conditions and may pose a biosafety concern.We investigated ocular involvement in naturally infected animals by histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular testing.Histopathology was conducted on 92 animals that tested positive for rabies via DFA.Ocular and lacrimal gland specimens (30 each) were independently selected for immunohistochemistry based on tissue availability, preservation, and adequacy to evaluate IL-6, IL-1β, TNFα, TLR3, TLR4, HSP70, CD3, and CD20.Molecular testing was performed on separate subsets of 50 fresh brain, 50 FFPE brain, and 50 vitreous humor samples selected based on specimen availability and analytical suitability.Typical lesions of rabies were observed, such as nonsuppurative meningoencephalitis, focal gliosis, and neuronal necrosis.There was no statistically significant difference in IL-6 positivity between ocular and lacrimal gland samples (P>0.05).HSP70 positivity was more frequent in lacrimal glands compared to ocular tissues (86.7% vs. 13.3%;P<0.0001), as was CD20 positivity (46.7% vs. 13.3%;P=0.0029).Rabies virus RNA was detected in 35/50 vitreous samples (70%) by LN34 qRT-PCR.The Ct values were generally higher in FFPE brain specimens than in fresh brain specimens.Detection of viral RNA in vitreous humor supports ocular involvement in centrifugal spread from the central nervous system.However, 15 samples of vitreous humor from DFA-positive animals were negative, suggesting that vitreous humor cannot be considered as an independent diagnostic specimen, but its potential role is supplementary and needs further evaluation.

analysis_zh.methods: 对92只DFA阳性动物进行了组织病理学检查。选择了眼部和泪腺组织进行免疫组织化学检测,以评估IL-6、IL-1β、TNFα、TLR3、TLR4、HSP70、CD3和CD20。分子检测涉及对50份新鲜脑组织、50份FFPE脑组织和50份玻璃体液样本进行qRT-PCR检测,样本选择基于标本的可获得性和分析适宜性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在眼组织和泪腺样本中,IL-6阳性率之间没有统计学显著差异(P>0.05)。与眼组织相比,泪腺中HSP70阳性率更高(86.7% vs. 13.3%;P<0.0001),CD20阳性率也更高(46.7% vs. 狂犬病病毒)。通过LN34 qRT-PCR检测,35/50玻璃体样本(70%)中检测到RNA。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在玻璃体液中检测到狂犬病病毒 RNA支持了眼睛在中枢神经系统向周围扩散中的参与。然而,15份DFA阳性动物的玻璃体液样本均为阴性,这表明玻璃体液不能被视为独立的诊断样本,但其潜在作用是补充性的,需要进一步评估。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,眼部组织,特别是泪腺,可能成为评估免疫应答在狂犬病感染中的替代部位。玻璃体液作为补充诊断样本的潜在应用,可能在现场环境中提高监测和诊断的诊断效果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于对死后样本的依赖以及组织保存过程中可能存在的变异性。证据等级为中等,因为研究结果基于观察性数据,需要在更大规模的研究中进一步验证。

papers.title: Microbiological safety assessment of canine adipose derived mesenchymal stem cell preparations reveal no detectable contamination
papers.abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess the microbiological safety of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cell (cAD-MSC) preparations, as their therapeutic application requires ensuring they are free from contamination that could compromise efficacy or pose risks to canine patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted at the Croatian Veterinary Institute, where 32 cAD-MSC preparations were tested for the presence of clinically significant pathogens, including rabies virus, using molecular PCR methods.
analysis.methods: Nucleic acids were extracted from the 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods to detect the presence of the specified pathogens, including rabies virus.
analysis.main_results: No gene fragments of rabies virus or any other tested pathogens were detected in the 32 cAD-MSC preparations, indicating they were free from contamination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the cAD-MSC preparations met sterility requirements, which is a novel confirmation of their safety for therapeutic use in canine patients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide critical information for ensuring the safety of cell-based therapies in veterinary medicine, particularly for rabies virus, which is a significant public health concern in canine populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to testing a specific set of pathogens, and the absence of contamination in the tested samples does not guarantee complete safety, though the evidence is strong given the rigorous testing protocol.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the microbiological safety of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cell (cAD-MSC) preparations by testing them for contamination with rabies virus and other pathogens. The research was motivated by the need to ensure the safety of these cells for therapeutic use, as their production involves in vitro isolation and expansion, which can introduce contamination risks. Using molecular PCR methods, 32 cAD-MSC samples were analyzed, and no gene fragments of rabies virus or other tested pathogens were detected, indicating the preparations were free from contamination. The findings suggest that the cAD-MSC preparations met sterility requirements, which is a novel confirmation of their safety for therapeutic use in canine patients. The study's results have important implications for veterinary medicine, particularly in ensuring the safety of cell-based therapies. However, the study is limited to testing a specific set of pathogens, and the absence of contamination in the tested samples does not guarantee complete safety, though the evidence is strong given the rigorous testing protocol.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估犬脂肪源性间充质干细胞 (cAD-MSC) 制剂的微生物安全性,因为其治疗应用需要确保它们不受污染,以免影响疗效或给犬类患者带来风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在克罗地亚兽医研究所进行,使用分子 PCR 方法测试了 32 种 cAD-MSC 制剂是否存在临床上重要的病原体,包括 狂犬病病毒。
elements_zh.methods: 从 32 个 cAD-MSC 制剂中提取核酸,并使用标准分子 PCR 方法进行分析,以检测特定病原体(包括 狂犬病病毒)的存在。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 32 个 cAD-MSC 制剂中未检测到 狂犬病病毒 或任何其他测试病原体的基因片段,表明它们没有污染。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,cAD-MSC 制剂满足无菌要求,这是对其在犬类患者治疗中的安全性的新确认。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为确保兽医学中基于细胞的疗法的安全性提供了关键信息,特别是 狂犬病病毒,它是犬类群体中一个重大的公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于测试一组特定的病原体,并且测试样本中没有污染并不能保证完全安全,尽管考虑到严格的测试方案,证据是强有力的。

papers.abstract_zh: 犬脂肪源性间充质干细胞/基质细胞(cAD-MSC)的实验应用已证明治疗对许多以前无法治疗或难以治疗的疾病具有优异的治疗潜力。然而,用于临床应用的cAD-MSC的生产需要体外分离和细胞扩增,从而引入微生物污染的风险。研究表明,储存的间充质干细胞可能被细菌、真菌或病毒污染,导致细胞转化、细胞死亡或持续感染。这最终会损害治疗效果并可能促进治疗诱导的病原体 传播。根据欧洲药品管理局指南,要求将无菌检测作为生产过程的一个组成部分,本研究旨在评估克罗地亚兽医研究所 cAD-MSC 库的无菌性。为了检测临床上最重要的犬病原体,从 32 个 cAD-MSC 制剂中提取核酸,并使用标准分子 PCR 方法进行分析。病原体筛查小组包括狂犬病病毒(狂犬病毒)、犬疱疹病毒(Varicellovirus canidalpha1)、细小病毒(Carnivore protoparvovirus 1)、冠状病毒(Alphacoronavirus 1)、犬瘟热病毒(Morbillivirus canis)、轮状病毒A、钩端螺旋体属、犬布鲁氏菌、伯氏疏螺旋体、无形体spp、埃利希体属、支原体属(嗜血性)和犬新孢子虫。没有检测到上述病原体的测试基因片段,表明cAD-MSC制剂不存在临床上显着的病原体。在细胞分离和扩增过程中严格实施无菌控制对于确保犬类患者的安全细胞治疗至关重要。

papers.title: A curvilinear coordinate flatmap for visualizing hippocampal structure and development.
papers.abstract: The hippocampal formation is a highly curved and topographically complex forebrain structure. This complex geometry presents persistent challenges for analyzing subregional, laminar, and connectivity patterns. Here, we present a computational workflow that generates curvilinear-coordinate flatmaps from mouse Common Coordinate Framework (CCF) registered hippocampal and retrohippocampal regions by solving the Laplacian equation to derive geodesic streamlines. This transformation unfolds the hippocampus into a planar slab, bounded by the meningeal and ventricular surfaces, with the depth defined along the radial axis. We apply this transform to mouse CCF-registered image volumes, single neuron reconstructions, and point cloud data, including spatial transcriptomic and rabies tracing datasets, revealing topographic variations in the dorsoventral and radial axes that are obscured in the CCF coordinate space. As proof of principle, we use flatmaps to show connectivity loss in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease and track postnatal development of microglial distribution in the hippocampus. This work provides an efficient and accessible resource for visualizing hippocampal organization across development and disease, offering new opportunities to interrogate the structure and function of this important brain region.

papers.abstract_zh: 海马体是一个高度弯曲且地形复杂的前脑结构。这种复杂的几何结构在分析亚区、层状结构和连接模式时带来了持续的挑战。在这里,我们提出了一种计算流程,通过求解拉普拉斯方程来推导测地线流线,从而从小鼠通用坐标框架(CCF)注册的海马体和后海马区生成曲面坐标平面图。这种转换将海马体展开为一个平面板,其边界由脑膜和脑室表面界定,深度沿径向轴定义。我们将这种转换应用于小鼠CCF注册的图像体积、单个神经元重建和点云数据,包括空间转录组学和狂犬病追踪数据集,揭示了在CCF坐标空间中被掩盖的背腹轴和径向轴上的地形变化。作为原理验证,我们利用平面图展示了阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型中的连接性丧失,并追踪了海马体中小胶质细胞分布的出生后发育情况。这项工作为可视化海马体在发育和疾病中的组织结构提供了高效且易于访问的资源,为今后研究这一重要脑区的结构和功能提供了新的机会。

papers.title: Viral Infection Across the Kidney Transplant Continuum: Screening, Prevention, Management, and Oncogenesis
papers.abstract: Viral infections influence every stage of the kidney transplantation continuum, shaping immunologic risk, graft outcomes, and long term patient survival. Pre transplant serologic assessments guide critical decisions, including vaccinations, the avoidance of lymphocyte depleting induction in Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) mismatched candidates and the selection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) prophylaxis tailored to donor–recipient serostatus. Acceptance of hepatitis C viremic donor organs has significantly reduced wait times, while human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive donor organs remain restricted to HIV positive recipients. Post transplant, viral pathogens are major drivers of morbidity: CMV functions as an immunomodulator that increases susceptibility to rejection and opportunistic fungal infections, and routine surveillance for CMV and BK viremia is essential, especially following rejection therapies. BK virus nephropathy, adenovirus nephropathy, and JC virus nephropathy can lead to progressive allograft dysfunction. Additionally, COVID 19 and parvovirus infections have been associated with collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) and severe graft injury. Persistent viral infections and virus associated glomerulopathies contribute to chronic graft loss, while EBV driven post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD) remains a significant cause of cancer related mortality. Transplant recipients are also at increased risk for persistent human papillomavirus infection (HPV) and progression to anogenital and oropharyngeal malignancies. Finally, donor derived viral infections, including rabies, West Nile virus (WNV), and lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV), though rare, are well described in the literature. Collectively, these viral complications substantially impact morbidity, graft survival, and overall mortality in kidney transplant recipients.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the impact of viral infections across the kidney transplant continuum, highlighting their influence on immunologic risk, graft outcomes, and long-term patient survival. It emphasizes the importance of pre-transplant serologic assessments in guiding decisions related to vaccinations, induction therapy, and CMV prophylaxis. The research also discusses the role of viral pathogens in post-transplant morbidity, including their contribution to allograft dysfunction and severe graft injury. The findings underscore the need for routine surveillance for CMV and BK viremia, especially after rejection therapies. The study notes that persistent viral infections and virus-associated glomerulopathies are linked to chronic graft loss and cancer-related mortality. While the evidence is primarily based on general observations and implications, the study provides a comprehensive overview of the challenges posed by viral infections in kidney transplant recipients. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the abstract-only nature of the report and the lack of detailed statistical or methodological analysis.

papers.abstract_zh: 病毒感染影响肾脏移植全过程的各个阶段,影响免疫学风险、移植物结局和长期患者生存率。移植前的血清学检测指导关键决策,包括疫苗接种,避免在EBV不匹配的供者中使用淋巴细胞耗竭诱导方案,并根据供者-受者血清状态选择针对性的巨细胞病毒(CMV)预防措施。接受丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)血清阳性供体器官的政策显著缩短了等待时间,而人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)阳性供体器官仍仅限于HIV阳性受者。移植后,病毒病原体是主要的发病率驱动因素:CMV作为一种免疫调节剂,会增加排斥反应和机会性真菌感染的易感性,且对CMV和BK病毒血症进行常规监测至关重要,尤其是在接受排斥治疗后。BK病毒肾病、腺病毒肾病和JC病毒肾病可能导致移植物功能进行性障碍。此外,新冠病毒(COVID 19)和细小病毒感染与塌陷性局灶节段性肾小球硬化(FSGS)和严重移植物损伤有关。持续的病毒感染和病毒相关性肾小球病会导致慢性移植物丢失,而EBV引发的移植后淋巴增殖性疾病(PTLD)仍是与癌症相关的死亡率的重要原因。移植受者还面临持续性人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染以及发展为生殖道和口咽恶性肿瘤的更高风险。最后,来源于供体的病毒感染,包括狂犬病、西尼罗河病毒(WNV)和淋巴细胞性脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV),尽管罕见,但在文献中已有详细描述。总体而言,这些病毒并发症显著影响移植受者的发病率、移植物存活率和整体死亡率。

papers.full_text: Multi-strain SIS dynamics with coinfection across heterogeneous patches Miguel B. Marˆocoa, Louis Pailloncyb, Sten Madecc, Erida Gjinia,d aCenter for Computational and Stochastic Mathematics, Instituto Superior Tecnico, University of Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal bENSTA, Paris, France cInstitut Denis Poisson, University of Tours, France dCorresponding author: erida.gjini@tecnico.ulisboa.pt Abstract We study a Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model with coinfection and multiple interacting strains where hosts move between a set of inter-connected patches. Under strain similarity and slow migration, we obtain a dis- crete model, following the corresponding continuous space model derived in (Le and Madec, 2023). In this model, the fast variables are total prevalence of susceptibles, single-infected and co-infected hosts in each patch (S, I, D). The slow variables are strain frequencies (z) in each patch. These local strain frequencies in each patch are governed by a replicator-like equation, where an additional contribution arises from migration, scaled explicitly by emergent patch heterogeneity. In our model, the strains can vary epidemiologically within- and between-patches along sev- eral traits, including transmission rates, clearance rates, priority effects and pairwise susceptibilities to coinfection; a complexity that totally defies straightforward prediction of their ecological outcome. However, harnessing the analytical advantage of this model reduction, we can investigate several key scenarios for the outcome of the cou- pled P-patch N-strain system. We focus on the global and local factors that promote or hinder coexistence, and on regimes that favour spatial segregation of strains, or ultimately competitive exclusion. The analytical tractability of this meta-population model, illustrated with several examples for N = 2 strains and 2-3 patches, makes it a useful framework for application to general multi-species co-colonization systems with migration across heterogeneous environments. Keywords: infectious diseases, meta-population, coinfection, competition, replicator equation, SIS model, interacting strains, heterogeneous environments 1. Introduction 1 Population dynamics in heterogeneous environments have many applications in biology, ecology, epidemiol- 2 ogy and medicine (Hanski, 1999; Okubo et al., 2001; Keeling et al., 2004). Typical modeling frameworks for 3 exploring population dynamics across different habitats involve logistic growth models plus diffusion (Arditi et al., 4 2018), Lotka-Volterra systems with migration between patches (Levin, 1974), chemostat models (Tan et al., 2019), 5 consumer-resource models with symmetric/asymmetric diffusion (Zhang et al., 2017), epidemiological compart- 6 mental models with different connected environments such as community-hospital, hospital-hospital, city X with 7 city Y, rural with urban area, disease spread on networks, etc. (Smith et al., 2004). In within-host infectious disease 8 models, the question of population dynamics across different habitats also emerges when studying virus dynam- 9 ics in different within-host niches (Wong and Yukl, 2016), or bacterial spatiotemporal dynamics across different 10 organs (Grant et al., 2008). On the theoretical side, the questions arising in these models are those concerning 11 the global persistence of the system (Butler et al., 1986), the influence of diffusion on the global stability and 12 magnitude of positive equilibrium (Arditi et al., 2015), the comparison with the total abundance/dynamics in non- 13 coupled system (Poggiale et al., 2005), the influence of environmental heterogeneity for persistence and stability, 14 and when different strains or species are modeled, how the competitive outcome between these players is altered 15 by diffusion and environmental heterogeneity. On the more practical side, the application of such models to real 16 data (Trindade et al., 2022; Grant et al., 2008; Korevaar et al., 2020; Price et al., 2017), involves the challenges 17 Preprint submitted to journal October 27, 2025 . CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 International license perpetuity. It is made available under a preprint (which was not certified by peer review) is the author/funder, who has granted bioRxiv a license to display the preprint in The copyright holder for this this version posted October 27, 2025. ; https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.26.684704 doi: bioRxiv preprint of suitable parametrization, parameter inference, uncertainty quantification and limits of predictability or control 18 in such systems. In a broader sense, models of population dynamics in heterogeneous environments have a clear 19 and direct bearing on global efforts towards conservation of biodiversity, health and stability of ecosystems and 20 modern coexistence theory. 21 In epidemiology, the study of spatiotemporal dynamics of infectious disease has a long history of study, first 22 with reaction-diffusion type models which consider space as a continuous variable (see e.g. (Noble, 1974) for early 23 models of plague and (K ̈all ́en et al., 1985; Murray et al., 1986) for early models on the spread of rabies), and more 24 recently with the application of multi-patch models (modeling space in discrete units), for example studying SIS 25 dynamics (McCormack and Allen, 2007; Arrigoni and Pugliese, 2002), application of aggregation methods under 26 fast migration assumptions (Kouokam et al., 2008; Marv ́a et al., 2012), vector-host epidemic models with multiple 27 strains in a patchy environment (Qiu et al., 2013) and multi-strain diseases on networks of interconnected patches 28 (Michalska-Smith et al., 2022). 29 In general, spatial and non-spatial models differ, and often even the mere addition of a spatial dimension and 30 random diffusion as a homogeneous variable to the non-spatial dynamics can have critical implications for the 31 persistence of a growing diffusive species (Skellam, 1951). Indeed, when space (or multiple patches) is heteroge- 32 neous, and diffusion is also space- or density-dependent, and when other parameters of growth and transmission 33 can vary with space, the infectious disease dynamics become inevitably much more complex. 34 In this work we will assume space is discrete. The motivation comes from the realization that many populations 35 of humans, livestock, and wildlife consist of densely occupied subpopulations, or “patches”, connected by the 36 movement of individuals, thus giving rise to a metapopulation. Today, most of the world’s population lives in cities, 37 farm animals are concentrated in specific areas, and wildlife often cluster where their habitats are fragmented. In 38 the past, people moved so little that new diseases usually stayed near where they began—like the Black Death in 39 medieval Europe or smallpox centuries ago. Now, with our world more connected than ever, infections such as 40 influenza, Ebola, and COVID-19 can spread faster and farther. As people travel more and science tracks pathogens 41 in greater detail, disease models need to capture the complex links between how different areas, hosts, and strains 42 interact. These connections ultimately shape how diseases spread and evolve, both locally and around the world. 43 Here, we contribute to this challenge by considering a multi-patch multi-strain SIS system with coinfec- 44 tion, strain interactions, and symmetric host migration between patches. The basic model structure follows the 45 Suscetible-Infected-Susceptible coinfection framework for N interacting strains proposed by Madec and Gjini 46 (2020), generalized by (Le et al., 2023) and extended to continuous space in (Le and Madec, 2023). 47 In the non-spatial model (Madec and Gjini, 2020; Le et al., 2023, 2022), it was shown that under strain simi- 48 larity, strain frequencies follow a slow dynamics given by the replicator equation: 49 d dτzi = Θzi ·  X j,i λj i zj − X 1≤k< j≤N (λk j + λj k)zjzk  , i = 1, · · · , N (1) where λj i denote pairwise invasion fitnesses between any two strains, and Θ gives the speed of the dynamics. In 50 the subsequent epidemiological model extension (Le and Madec, 2023), allowing for spatial diffusion of hosts, a 51 similar model reduction was obtained, and in the case of low-diffusion a replicator-like equation was again derived 52 for strain frequencies over space. 53 In the present work, we will consider the same epidemiological multi-strain model but over discrete space, 54 where we assume hosts can move between a set of fully-connected heterogeneous patches. Our aims are three- 55 fold: i) to present the equation governing strain frequencies over discrete patches and its properties, ii) to illustrate 56 and analyze special cases of these dynamics for N = 2 in the case of P = 2 or 3 patches, iii) to suggest ways in 57 which this model representation can be theoretically studied and extended. 58 In a companion purely theoretical paper (Madec and Gjini, 2025), we show the same model arrived here to 59 via discretization of the spatial PDE (Le and Madec, 2023), can be obtained by application from scratch of the 60 slow-fast method on the epidemiological multi-strain multi-patch model. Indeed, this replicator equation, contains 61 a local selection term, plus an explicit contribution term from host migration coupled with the environmental 62 difference between patches, making it amenable to analysis and more efficient computation. 63 2 . The model - metacommunity of hosts across P patches and N co-circulating strains 64 2.1. The SIS model with coinfection and host migration across patches 65 We describe the model over a discrete set of P separate patches. Susceptible individuals are infected upon con- 66 tact with infected individuals at a rate β. Single infected can become co-infected upon further contact with infected 67 individuals, but with an altered susceptibility coefficient, relative to a susceptible host. The altered susceptibility 68 parameters between strains are carried on, like in the earlier formulations (Madec and Gjini, 2020), and introduced 69 in the form of a matrix of coefficients kij, which when above 1 indicate facilitation between strains i and j and 70 when below 1, indicate competition. Single infected individuals and coinfected individuals recover from infection 71 back to the susceptible class at equal global rate γ, but there can be differences in clearing infection by each strain 72 γi, or composite infections γi j (for coinfection). There is no virulence so population size remains constant, with 73 susceptibles having recruitment rate r, equal to the population per capita death rate. Strain dissimilarity is modelled 74 through a parameter ε, which applies to all strain-specific parameters of the model. This formulation together with 75 the biological meaning of all parameters is summarized in Table 1. 76 Note that all variables and parameters are to be understood as P-dimensional column vectors, with each entry 77 being associated to one of the patches. With this, the equations of the model, describing host proportions in 78 different compartments, translated to discrete P-dimensional space, are: 79 dS dt = r(1 −S) + N X i=1 γiIi + N X i, j=1 γi jDi j −S N X i=1 βiJi + δDS (2) dIi dt = βiJiS −(r + γi)Ii −Ii N X j=1 ki jβjJ j + δDIi, i = {1, ..N} (3) dDi j dt = kijβjIiJj −(r + γi j)Di j + δDDi j, i, j = {1, ...N} (4) with D = (dpk)p,k ∈RP×P a Metzler matrix relating the connectivity between patches. full_text_sections.full_text: Multi-strain SIS dynamics with coinfection across heterogeneous patches Miguel B. Marˆocoa, Louis Pailloncyb, Sten Madecc, Erida Gjinia,d aCenter for Computational and Stochastic Mathematics, Instituto Superior Tecnico, University of Lisbon, Lisbon, Portugal bENSTA, Paris, France cInstitut Denis Poisson, University of Tours, France dCorresponding author: erida.gjini@tecnico.ulisboa.pt Abstract We study a Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model with coinfection and multiple interacting strains where hosts move between a set of inter-connected patches. Under strain similarity and slow migration, we obtain a dis- crete model, following the corresponding continuous space model derived in (Le and Madec, 2023). In this model, the fast variables are total prevalence of susceptibles, single-infected and co-infected hosts in each patch (S, I, D). The slow variables are strain frequencies (z) in each patch. These local strain frequencies in each patch are governed by a replicator-like equation, where an additional contribution arises from migration, scaled explicitly by emergent patch heterogeneity. In our model, the strains can vary epidemiologically within- and between-patches along sev- eral traits, including transmission rates, clearance rates, priority effects and pairwise susceptibilities to coinfection; a complexity that totally defies straightforward prediction of their ecological outcome. However, harnessing the analytical advantage of this model reduction, we can investigate several key scenarios for the outcome of the cou- pled P-patch N-strain system. We focus on the global and local factors that promote or hinder coexistence, and on regimes that favour spatial segregation of strains, or ultimately competitive exclusion. The analytical tractability of this meta-population model, illustrated with several examples for N = 2 strains and 2-3 patches, makes it a useful framework for application to general multi-species co-colonization systems with migration across heterogeneous environments. Keywords: infectious diseases, meta-population, coinfection, competition, replicator equation, SIS model, interacting strains, heterogeneous environments 1. Introduction 1 Population dynamics in heterogeneous environments have many applications in biology, ecology, epidemiol- 2 ogy and medicine (Hanski, 1999; Okubo et al., 2001; Keeling et al., 2004). Typical modeling frameworks for 3 exploring population dynamics across different habitats involve logistic growth models plus diffusion (Arditi et al., 4 2018), Lotka-Volterra systems with migration between patches (Levin, 1974), chemostat models (Tan et al., 2019), 5 consumer-resource models with symmetric/asymmetric diffusion (Zhang et al., 2017), epidemiological compart- 6 mental models with different connected environments such as community-hospital, hospital-hospital, city X with 7 city Y, rural with urban area, disease spread on networks, etc. (Smith et al., 2004). In within-host infectious disease 8 models, the question of population dynamics across different habitats also emerges when studying virus dynam- 9 ics in different within-host niches (Wong and Yukl, 2016), or bacterial spatiotemporal dynamics across different 10 organs (Grant et al., 2008). On the theoretical side, the questions arising in these models are those concerning 11 the global persistence of the system (Butler et al., 1986), the influence of diffusion on the global stability and 12 magnitude of positive equilibrium (Arditi et al., 2015), the comparison with the total abundance/dynamics in non- 13 coupled system (Poggiale et al., 2005), the influence of environmental heterogeneity for persistence and stability, 14 and when different strains or species are modeled, how the competitive outcome between these players is altered 15 by diffusion and environmental heterogeneity. On the more practical side, the application of such models to real 16 data (Trindade et al., 2022; Grant et al., 2008; Korevaar et al., 2020; Price et al., 2017), involves the challenges 17 Preprint submitted to journal October 27, 2025 . CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 International license perpetuity. It is made available under a preprint (which was not certified by peer review) is the author/funder, who has granted bioRxiv a license to display the preprint in The copyright holder for this this version posted October 27, 2025. ; https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.26.684704 doi: bioRxiv preprint of suitable parametrization, parameter inference, uncertainty quantification and limits of predictability or control 18 in such systems. In a broader sense, models of population dynamics in heterogeneous environments have a clear 19 and direct bearing on global efforts towards conservation of biodiversity, health and stability of ecosystems and 20 modern coexistence theory. 21 In epidemiology, the study of spatiotemporal dynamics of infectious disease has a long history of study, first 22 with reaction-diffusion type models which consider space as a continuous variable (see e.g. (Noble, 1974) for early 23 models of plague and (K ̈all ́en et al., 1985; Murray et al., 1986) for early models on the spread of rabies), and more 24 recently with the application of multi-patch models (modeling space in discrete units), for example studying SIS 25 dynamics (McCormack and Allen, 2007; Arrigoni and Pugliese, 2002), application of aggregation methods under 26 fast migration assumptions (Kouokam et al., 2008; Marv ́a et al., 2012), vector-host epidemic models with multiple 27 strains in a patchy environment (Qiu et al., 2013) and multi-strain diseases on networks of interconnected patches 28 (Michalska-Smith et al., 2022). 29 In general, spatial and non-spatial models differ, and often even the mere addition of a spatial dimension and 30 random diffusion as a homogeneous variable to the non-spatial dynamics can have critical implications for the 31 persistence of a growing diffusive species (Skellam, 1951). Indeed, when space (or multiple patches) is heteroge- 32 neous, and diffusion is also space- or density-dependent, and when other parameters of growth and transmission 33 can vary with space, the infectious disease dynamics become inevitably much more complex. 34 In this work we will assume space is discrete. The motivation comes from the realization that many populations 35 of humans, livestock, and wildlife consist of densely occupied subpopulations, or “patches”, connected by the 36 movement of individuals, thus giving rise to a metapopulation. Today, most of the world’s population lives in cities, 37 farm animals are concentrated in specific areas, and wildlife often cluster where their habitats are fragmented. In 38 the past, people moved so little that new diseases usually stayed near where they began—like the Black Death in 39 medieval Europe or smallpox centuries ago. Now, with our world more connected than ever, infections such as 40 influenza, Ebola, and COVID-19 can spread faster and farther. As people travel more and science tracks pathogens 41 in greater detail, disease models need to capture the complex links between how different areas, hosts, and strains 42 interact. These connections ultimately shape how diseases spread and evolve, both locally and around the world. 43 Here, we contribute to this challenge by considering a multi-patch multi-strain SIS system with coinfec- 44 tion, strain interactions, and symmetric host migration between patches. The basic model structure follows the 45 Suscetible-Infected-Susceptible coinfection framework for N interacting strains proposed by Madec and Gjini 46 (2020), generalized by (Le et al., 2023) and extended to continuous space in (Le and Madec, 2023). 47 In the non-spatial model (Madec and Gjini, 2020; Le et al., 2023, 2022), it was shown that under strain simi- 48 larity, strain frequencies follow a slow dynamics given by the replicator equation: 49 d dτzi = Θzi ·  X j,i λj i zj − X 1≤k< j≤N (λk j + λj k)zjzk  , i = 1, · · · , N (1) where λj…

papers.title_original: Multi-strain SIS dynamics with coinfection across heterogeneous patches

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the dynamics of multi-strain SIS models with coinfection across heterogeneous patches, addressing the challenge of predicting ecological outcomes in such systems.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research involved a theoretical analysis of a meta-population model with multiple interacting strains and heterogeneous patches, focusing on the behavior of strain frequencies and host dynamics across these patches.
analysis.methods: The model used a replicator-like equation to describe strain frequencies, incorporating parameters such as transmission rates, clearance rates, and migration rates, with assumptions about constant total population and renormalization to 1.
analysis.main_results: The study derived equations for the steady-state values of susceptible, single-infected, and co-infected hosts in each patch, showing how these depend on the basic reproduction number and other parameters.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as demonstrating how strain frequencies and host dynamics evolve in heterogeneous environments, highlighting the model's ability to capture complex interactions through simplified equations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding multi-strain disease dynamics in spatially structured populations, which can inform surveillance and control strategies in heterogeneous environments.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical analysis and does not include empirical data, which reduces the strength of evidence to moderate. The model assumes constant total population and may not fully capture real-world complexities.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a theoretical analysis of a Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model with coinfection across heterogeneous patches. The research focuses on understanding how strain frequencies and host dynamics evolve in such environments, using a replicator-like equation to describe the system. The model incorporates parameters like transmission rates, clearance rates, and migration rates, with assumptions about constant total population and renormalization. The main results include equations for the steady-state values of susceptible, single-infected, and co-infected hosts in each patch, which depend on the basic reproduction number and other factors. The authors interpret these results as showing how strain frequencies and host dynamics are influenced by environmental heterogeneity and migration. The study's theoretical nature limits its evidence strength to moderate, as it does not include empirical data. The findings offer a framework for analyzing multi-strain disease dynamics in spatially structured populations, which could inform surveillance and control strategies in heterogeneous settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨多株SIS模型在异质斑块间的共感染动态,解决在这些系统中预测生态结果的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及对一个具有多株相互作用的元种群模型的理论分析,重点关注这些斑块中株频率和宿主动态的行为。
elements_zh.methods: The model used a replicator-like equation to describe strain frequencies, incorporating parameters such as transmission rates, clearance rates, and migration rates, with assumptions about constant total population and renormalization to 1.
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究推导了每个斑块中易感、单感染和共感染宿主的稳态值方程,展示了这些值如何依赖于基本再生数和其他参数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为表明株频率和宿主动态如何在异质环境中演变,突出了该模型通过简化方程捕捉复杂相互作用的能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为理解空间结构种群中多株疾病的动态提供了理论框架,可用于指导监测和控制策略在异质环境中的应用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论分析,未包含实证数据,这降低了证据强度至中等水平。该模型假设总人口恒定,可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性。

This is the seventeenth confirmed case of animal rabies in 2026. North Carolina law requires that all domestic pets (cats, dogs and ferrets), whether living inside or outside, aged four months or older be vaccinated for rabies. Animals that are confined in outdoor fenced areas should also have current rabies vaccinations. Supervising pets when they are outdoors could prevent contact with wild animals and lessen the possibility of rabies exposure. Guilford County Animal Services may be contacted for more information on rabies prevention at 336-641-2506 or visit our Animal Services website. For information regarding the current rabies cases, please contact Jorge Ortega at 336-641-3409 or jortega1@guilfordcountync.gov. Rabies circulates within our wildlife population throughout the entire year. Here are some tips to help prevent you or your family from being exposed to the rabies virus: Avoid direct contact with wildlife, dead or alive. Do not approach, try to play with, touch, rescue or treat any wildlife. If you find a sick or injured animal, contact Animal Control at 336-641-5990. Avoid any animal displaying unnatural behavior. Wild animals are not usually friendly so be very careful if they approach you. Do not try to separate fighting animals. Feed your pets indoors. Leaving food outside will attract dogs, cats and other wildlife into your yard. Report all stray animals to Animal Control at 336-641-5990 in Greensboro and 336-883-3224 in High Point. Stray animals may not have current rabies vaccinations. If a person is bitten by an animal (domestic or stray), wash the bitten area immediately with soap and water, seek medical attention, and report the bite to local Animal Control Officers. news.title_zh: 格利尔福县确认2026年第十七例动物狂犬病病例 - 格利尔福县(.gov)
news.source_body_en: Guilford County, North Carolina, confirmed the seventeenth case of animal rabies in 2026 on November 4, 2026. The affected animal was a skunk found on Deer Stand Court in Browns Summit. The Guilford County Health and Human Services Agency - Department of Public Health reported the case, emphasizing the ongoing risk of rabies in the local wildlife population. Public health guidance includes avoiding contact with wildlife, supervising pets outdoors, and reporting stray animals to Animal Control. Residents are encouraged to contact Guilford County Animal Services at 336-641-2506 or Jorge Ortega at 336-641-3409 for more information on rabies prevention. The county also highlights the importance of vaccinating domestic pets and keeping food indoors to reduce the risk of rabies exposure.
news.content_zh: 北卡罗来纳州格利尔福县于2026年11月4日确认了2026年第十七例动物狂犬病病例。受影响的动物是一只在布朗斯苏姆特的鹿站街发现的臭鼬。格利尔福县卫生与人类服务局-公共卫生部报告了该病例,强调了狂犬病在本地野生动物种群中持续存在的风险。公共卫生指导包括避免与野生动物接触、监督宠物在户外活动以及向动物控制部门报告流浪动物。居民如需了解更多关于狂犬病预防的信息,可联系格利尔福县动物服务部门,电话336-641-2506,或联系Jorge Ortega,电话336-641-3409。该县还强调了为家养宠物接种疫苗以及将食物留在室内以降低狂犬病暴露风险的重要性。

This alert highlights the risk of exposure to the raccoon in the area and urges residents to take precautions. The advisory is part of an official health response, with no reported human cases or additional animal cases. The department has not provided specific details on contact tracing or isolation measures, but it is likely implementing standard rabies prevention protocols. The event is limited in scope, affecting only the Sparr community, and the risk remains localized to potential interactions with the infected raccoon. No further information on the spread or health-system impact is available in the supplied evidence.

news.content_zh: 佛罗里达州马里昂县卫生部于2026年11月2日发布了一项狂犬病警报,以应对在Sparr附近一只浣熊中确认的狂犬病病例。该警报强调了该地区与浣熊接触的风险,并敦促居民采取预防措施。该警报是官方卫生响应的一部分,目前未报告有人类病例或额外的动物病例。卫生部尚未提供关于接触追踪或隔离措施的具体细节,但很可能正在实施标准的狂犬病预防协议。该事件影响范围有限,仅影响Sparr社区,风险仍局限于与感染浣熊的潜在互动。目前提供的证据中没有关于传播或对卫生系统影响的进一步信息。

Advertisement Merck Animal Health has announced the US availability of Nobivac NXT 1-Rabies and Nobivac NXT 3-Rabies, next-generation rabies vaccines for healthy dogs and cats 12 weeks of age or older. Nobivac NXT 3-Rabies provides a 3-year duration of immunity after a repeat dose.1 The launch follows a Health Alert Network Health Advisory from the CDC on a nationwide increase in reported human rabies exposures, underscoring the role companion animal vaccination plays in protecting both pets and people.2 Both vaccines are built on the company's Nobivac NXT platform and are nonadjuvanted, preservative-free, antibiotic-free, and thimerosal-free. They are delivered in a low-volume 0.5-mL dose intended to support comfort and ease of administration for veterinary teams and patients.1 “With Nobivac NXT Rabies, veterinarians now have an innovative option designed to provide trusted rabies protection while supporting a positive vaccination experience for pets, veterinary teams, and pet owners alike,” Meg Conlon, DVM, executive director of US companion animal veterinary services at Merck Animal Health, said in the release.1 “Vaccination remains a cornerstone of rabies prevention, but advances in vaccine technology also create opportunities to improve the vaccination experience,” added Laura Greene, DVM, DACVIM (SAIM), internal veterinary medicine specialist at Merck Animal Health.1 Rabies activity is climbing Advertisement Rabies is a zoonotic viral disease that is nearly 100% fatal but preventable when postexposure prophylaxis (PEP) is given appropriately before symptoms begin. Infected animals can transmit the virus to humans and other animals through bites, scratches, or oral secretions.2 Since July 2026, multiple US jurisdictions have reported local increases in human exposures involving both known rabies vectors and species in which rabies is less commonly reported, according to the CDC. From July through August, the agency received 17% more rabies-related inquiries than during the same period in 2025, including reports of mass exposure events, and at least 8 state health departments reported increased PEP use, PEP administration errors, or both.2 Related: Q&A: A rabies expert on rising exposure reports and keeping human cases rare Each year, approximately 100,000 people in the US receive PEP. As of September 2, 2026, use of licensed human rabies vaccines and human rabies immune globulin (HRIG) products had increased by an estimated 33% and 76%, respectively, compared with the same period last year. Although no shortage exists, a typical PEP course costs $11,000 to $14,000 per person.2 What it means for veterinary teams Veterinarians often sit at the center of the decision about whether a bitten person needs PEP. The CDC notes that PEP is generally not recommended when the biting animal is available for a 10-day observation period, tests negative, or is judged by health officials to pose no rabies risk, and that observing an available animal, in consultation with a veterinarian, may be a reasonable alternative to testing. The agency also advises people bitten by someone else's pet to request proof of current rabies vaccination, making accurate, accessible vaccination records essential.2 The advisory also gives veterinarians ready-made client talking points: Keep pets current on rabies vaccines and away from wildlife, and treat normally nocturnal species, such as bats and raccoons, seen during the day as a warning sign.2 The guidance matters for veterinary team members themselves, too. People who have completed a pre- or postexposure series—or a partial series with a documented titer of at least 0.5 IU/mL—should receive 2 vaccine doses on days 0 and 3 and no HRIG after an exposure, whereas never-vaccinated people need HRIG plus 4 doses. Misclassifying prior vaccination history is among the common PEP errors the CDC lists, so staff who keep records of their rabies vaccination and titer results can help ensure they receive appropriate care.2 References Merck Animal Health launches Nobivac NXT Rabies for dogs and cats in the United States. News release. Merck Animal Health. November 2, 2026. analysis.time: The news report was published on November 3, 2026. The event date is not explicitly stated, but the CDC issued a Health Alert Network Health Advisory in July 2026, noting a nationwide increase in reported human rabies exposures. The evidence mentions that from July through August 2026, the CDC received 17% more rabies-related inquiries than during the same period in 2025, and as of September 2, 2026, use of licensed human rabies vaccines and HRIG products had increased by 33% and 76%, respectively.
analysis.location_and_population: The report focuses on the United States, specifically mentioning multiple US jurisdictions and at least 8 state health departments. The affected population includes dogs, cats, and humans, with emphasis on companion animals and people bitten by animals.
analysis.event: Merck Animal Health launched nonadjuvanted rabies vaccines for dogs and cats in the US. This event was reported by Merck Animal Health and is confirmed by the CDC's warning about a nationwide increase in reported human rabies exposures. The vaccines are part of the Nobivac NXT platform and are designed to provide rabies protection while improving the vaccination experience for pets and veterinary teams.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The CDC reported a nationwide increase in human rabies exposures, with 17% more rabies-related inquiries from July to August 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. At least 8 state health departments reported increased PEP use, administration errors, or both. The report also mentions that as of September 2, 2026, use of licensed human rabies vaccines and HRIG products had increased by 33% and 76%, respectively. Rabies is a zoonotic viral disease that is nearly 100% fatal but preventable with appropriate PEP.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Merck Animal Health has launched the vaccines, and the CDC has issued a Health Alert Network Health Advisory. The CDC advises that PEP is generally not recommended when the biting animal is available for a 10-day observation period, tests negative, or is judged to pose no rabies risk. The report also highlights the importance of accurate vaccination records and the need for veterinary teams to provide client talking points regarding rabies prevention.

analysis.brief_en: Merck Animal Health has launched nonadjuvanted rabies vaccines for dogs and cats in the United States, following a CDC Health Alert Network Health Advisory on a nationwide increase in reported human rabies exposures. The vaccines, Nobivac NXT 1-Rabies and Nobivac NXT 3-Rabies, are designed to provide rabies protection while improving the vaccination experience for pets and veterinary teams. The CDC noted that from July to August 2026, there were 17% more rabies-related inquiries than in the same period in 2025, with at least 8 state health departments reporting increased PEP use or administration errors. As of September 2, 2026, use of licensed human rabies vaccines and HRIG products had increased by 33% and 76%, respectively. The CDC emphasizes that PEP is not always necessary if the biting animal is available for observation and tests negative. The report highlights the importance of maintaining accurate vaccination records and the role of veterinary teams in advising clients on rabies prevention. The CDC also advises that people bitten by someone else's pet should request proof of current rabies vaccination.

The CDC emphasizes that PEP is not always necessary if the biting animal is available for observation and tests negative. The report highlights the importance of maintaining accurate vaccination records and the role of veterinary teams in advising clients on rabies prevention. The CDC also advises that people bitten by someone else's pet should request proof of current rabies vaccination.

elements_zh.time: 该新闻报道于2026年11月3日发布。事件日期未明确说明,但CDC于2026年7月发布了健康警报网络健康通告,指出全国范围内报告的人类狂犬病暴露病例有所增加。报道提到,2026年7月至8月期间,CDC收到的与狂犬病相关的咨询数量比2025年同期增加了17%,截至2026年9月2日,已获得许可的人类狂犬病 疫苗疫苗和HRIG产品的使用量分别增加了33%和76%。
elements_zh.location_and_population: 该报告聚焦于美国,特别提到了多个美国司法管辖区和至少8个州的卫生部门。受影响的人群包括犬、猫和人类,重点强调了伴侣动物和被动物咬伤的人。
elements_zh.event: 默克动物健康公司在美国推出了非佐剂狂犬病疫苗狂犬病 疫苗,用于犬和猫。这一事件由默克动物健康公司报告,并得到了CDC关于全国范围内报告的人类狂犬病暴露病例增加的警告的确认。疫苗疫苗属于Nobivac NXT平台,旨在提供狂犬病保护,同时改善宠物和兽医团队的疫苗接种体验。
elements_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: CDC报告称,全国范围内人类狂犬病暴露病例有所增加,2026年7月至8月期间,与狂犬病相关的咨询数量比2025年同期增加了17%。至少有8个州的卫生部门报告了PEP使用量增加、管理错误或两者兼有。报告还提到,截至2026年9月2日,已获得许可的人类狂犬病 疫苗疫苗和HRIG产品的使用量分别增加了33%和76%。狂犬病是一种人兽共患病病毒,几乎100%致命,但通过适当的PEP可以预防。
elements_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 默克动物健康公司已推出疫苗疫苗,CDC发布了健康警报网络健康通告。CDC建议,如果被咬动物可以接受10天的观察并检测为阴性,或者被判断不具有狂犬病风险,则通常不推荐使用PEP。报告还强调了保持准确的疫苗接种记录的重要性,以及兽医团队在向客户提供关于狂犬病预防的建议方面的必要性。

news.content: Search for: Science Archaeology Ask Us Anything Biology Dinosaurs Physics Popular Science Videos Space The Weirdest Thing I Learned This Week Technology AI Aviation Engineering Internet Military Photography Robots Security Best of What's New Vehicles Environment Agriculture Animals Climate Change Conservation Energy Sustainability Weather DIY Life Skills Projects Tech Hacks Gear Audio Cameras Computers Fitness Gear Gaming Gift Guides Home Home Theater Outdoor Gear Phones Tablets Wearables MERCH Cover Art Store Newsletter Search for: Science Ask Us Anything Do you need a preventative rabies vaccine? Probably not. It might seem like a good idea, but it could just complicate things for your doctor. By Nicole Audrey Spector Published Nov 3, 2026 8:07 AM EST Add Popular Science (opens in a new tab) More information Adding us as a Preferred Source in Google by using this link indicates that you would like to see more of our content in Google News results. Once most frequently seen in dogs, rabies is now contracted by a range of wildlife like raccoons and foxes. Image: Philippe Gerber / Getty Images Of all the deadly diseases that can spread from mammals to humans, rabies is the most infamous. Cujo had it. Old Yeller had it. A squirrel in “National Lampoon’s Christmas Vacation” had it. Unfortunately, this virus doesn’t only live in fiction. It kills at least 59,000 people a year and is present in over 150 countries. On that list is the U.S., which is seeing a nationwide surge in reported cases of human exposures to rabid or possibly rabid animals. If left untreated, rabies is always fatal (both for animals and humans). On the bright side, it’s also 100 percent preventable. Typically, in the U.S., humans get vaccinated for rabies after suspected rabies exposure, but right now many of us are wondering: Can and should you get vaccinated against rabies just as a precaution? Is there any benefit in getting a preventative rabies vaccine? The simple answer is no. Getting a pre-exposure vaccine doesn’t protect you from contracting the disease, and if you have an encounter with an animal that might have rabies, you’ll still need to get follow up doses regardless. Debunking myths about the rabies vaccine Before diving in, let’s clear up some common misconceptions about rabies and the rabies vaccine. Rabies is a zoonotic virus that comes in two types: furious rabies and paralytic rabies. Both types of rabies attack the central nervous system and both are fatal. Any mammal can be infected with rabies, and if infected, can transmit it to other animals or humans through a bite or scratch—even if you can’t see or feel the wound. Though rabies doesn’t turn its victims into people-eating zombies, as Hollywood would have us believe, it does deliver an acutely agonizing death. The modern vaccine for rabies is made from cell culture. A cell culture vaccine contains no live virus. It is literally impossible for you to get rabies from the vaccine, which, you may be surprised to hear, is also pretty painless. Is the rabies vaccine painful? “The rabies vaccine is no more painful than a flu shot,” Dr. Edward R. Rensimer, a board-certified doctor of infectious diseases and internal medicine and director of the International Medicine Center in Houston, tells Popular Science. If exposed to a rabid or possibly rabid animal, you will require more than one dose of a rabies vaccine. “The injection site and number of doses recommended are dependent on the type of exposure you’ve had to a potentially rabid animal,” says Dr. Mirava Yuson, an epidemiologist and postdoctoral researcher working at the UCLA TIDE (Translational Infectious Disease Eco-epidemiology) Lab. “You can expect, for example, that a bite wound induced by an animal that’s suspected to be rabid, versus a light scratch from an animal that is not suspected to have rabies, will merit different doses and numbers of recommended boosters that are needed to complete a vaccine series.” The rabies vaccine is typically administered after an exposure has occurred. Image: Whispyhistory / CC BY-SA 4.0 The rabies vaccine is very safe Both Yuson and Rensimer cannot overstate the safety and efficacy of the rabies vaccine and emphasize that side effects, should they occur, are minimal. “It is analogous to the flu vaccine,” Rensimer says, adding that in his more than 45 years of administering the vaccine he’s never seen a major adverse event. “A very small minority of people in the 24 hours after the first dose may have low-grade fever, body aches, and malaise.” Should you get the rabies vaccine to prevent getting the disease? So, the rabies vaccine is a totally safe, 100 percent effective, and generally gentle vaccine? Sign us up! In all seriousness, why wouldn’t we get this vaccine, regardless of exposure risk, especially now, when rabies outbreaks and mass rabies exposure events are on the rise across the U.S.? Turns out there are a couple reasons why getting the rabies vaccine without any known risk exposure doesn’t make sense. First, the “better safe than sorry” approach doesn’t work with rabies. Getting a rabies shot before a risk exposure event does not prevent you from becoming infected with rabies, nor does it minimize the effects of the fatal virus should you get it.
